evidence.text:
str_replace /app/build.sh
--- old
# Copy source tree excluding patterns
echo "Copying and filtering source tree..."
rsync -a \
    --exclude='.git/' \
    --exclude='node_modules/' \
    --exclude='tmp/' \
    --exclude='.cache/' \
    --exclude='__pycache__/' \
    --exclude='*.tmp' \
    --exclude='*.pyc' \
    --exclude='*.o' \
    "$SOURCE_DIR/" "$WORK_DIR/"
+++ new
# Copy source tree excluding patterns
echo "Copying and filtering source tree..."
# Use find and tar to copy, excluding specified patterns
cd "$SOURCE_DIR"
find . -type d \( -name '.git' -o -name 'node_modules' -o -name 'tmp' -o -name '.cache' -o -name '__pycache__' \) -prune -o \
       -type f \( -name '*.tmp' -o -name '*.pyc' -o -name '*.o' \) -prune -o \
       -type f -print -o -type l -print -o -type d -print | \
    tar -cf - -T - | (cd "$WORK_DIR" && tar -xf -)
